steps.stepDescription: Open a web browser and navigate to the website using the provided URL.

subSteps.subStepDescription: Navigate to the provided website URL in the browser address bar.

steps.stepDescription: Select the 'enquiries' tab from the sidebar menu to view enquiry records.

subSteps.subStepDescription: Click the "Enquiries" link in the sidebar menu.

attempts.instruction: click the Enquiries link in the sidebar menu
attempts.refinedInstruction: Click the Enquiries link in the main sidebar navigation menu on the Kargone Admin page. IMPORTANT: Select the primary sidebar menu item labeled 'Enquiries', not any similar link in the main content area, header, or footer.

subSteps.subStepDescription: SKIP: The Enquiries page is already open and the sidebar Enquiries link has been clicked.

steps.stepDescription: Click on the date range selection element to open the calendar picker.

subSteps.subStepDescription: Click the "Select Date Range" button to open the calendar picker.

attempts.refinedInstruction: Click the 'Select Date Range' button on the page. IMPORTANT: Click the main date range selection button used to open the date picker or filter control, not any similarly labeled text, dropdown item, or nested element inside another control.

subSteps.subStepDescription: SKIP: The date range selection element has already been clicked and the calendar picker is open.

steps.stepDescription: Select the start date as 1st April from the calendar.

subSteps.subStepDescription: Click the day button labeled “Wednesday, April 1st, 2026” in the calendar.

attempts.instruction: click the day button labeled "Wednesday, April 1st, 2026" in the calendar
attempts.refinedInstruction: Click the day button labeled "Wednesday, April 1st, 2026" in the calendar. IMPORTANT: Select the date button itself in the calendar grid, not any surrounding navigation controls, month/year selectors, or other calendar elements.

subSteps.subStepDescription: SKIP: The start date has already been selected by clicking April 1st, 2026.

steps.stepDescription: Select the end date as 27th May from the calendar.

subSteps.subStepDescription: Click the day button labeled “Wednesday, May 27th, 2026” in the calendar.

attempts.instruction: click the day button labeled "Wednesday, May 27th, 2026" in the calendar
attempts.refinedInstruction: Click the day button labeled "Wednesday, May 27th, 2026" in the calendar. IMPORTANT: Select the calendar day button itself, not any surrounding date picker controls, month navigation arrows, or other calendar elements.

subSteps.subStepDescription: SKIP: The end date has already been selected as Wednesday, May 27th, 2026.

steps.stepDescription: Click on the 'done' button to confirm the selected date range.

subSteps.subStepDescription: Click the “Done” button to confirm the selected date range.

attempts.refinedInstruction: Click the 'Done' button on the Kargone Admin enquiries page. IMPORTANT: Click the primary action button labeled 'Done' in the main content area, not any similarly named link, menu item, or secondary control.

subSteps.subStepDescription: SKIP: The done button has already been clicked to confirm the selected date range.

steps.stepDescription: Open the sort dropdown and choose the 'oldest first' option to reorder the list.

subSteps.subStepDescription: Click the “Sort by” dropdown button.

attempts.refinedInstruction: Click the 'Sort by' dropdown button on the page. IMPORTANT: Click the main sorting control for the enquiries list, not any other dropdowns, filters, or menu buttons in the header or sidebar.

subSteps.subStepDescription: Click the View button for the top enquiry card to open its detailed view.

attempts.instruction: click the View button for the top enquiry card
attempts.refinedInstruction: Click the View button on the top enquiry card in the main content area. IMPORTANT: Click the primary View action for the first/top enquiry card, not any View button in other cards, side panels, or nested elements.
